name: WeChat Article Formatter
description: Format WeChat articles with templates and optional CSS, then preview, copy rich text or export HTML.
permission.read: Read the active note, including unsaved changes.
permission.clipboard: Copy formatted articles only when you click Copy.
permission.export: Save article HTML through a native save dialog.
permission.images: Optionally embed raster images from approved attachment folders.
css.help: Optional. Use CSS for finer styling after the parameters and base style. Selectors must start with .article; imports, URLs, variables and pseudo selectors are not supported.
empty: Open a Markdown note, then refresh the preview.
stale: The note changed. Refresh before copying or exporting.
copied: Formatted article copied. Verify the result in the WeChat editor.
invalidColor: Enter a six-digit hex color, for example #2563eb.
invalidValue: Enter a valid value within the allowed range.
configureHint: Each template keeps its own settings on this device. Formatting does not change the original Markdown.
capabilityMissing: This host lacks document preview support. Upgrade NoteGen.
templateNameRequired: Enter a template name (up to 60 characters).
templateLimit: You can save up to 20 custom templates.
templateNameExists: A template with this name already exists.
